name: BytesSent
description: Cumulative bytes sent.

name: CaptureFpsAvailable
description: Whether the capture source reports a frame rate at all.

name: CapturePath
description: Capture path in use (native broadcaster).

name: Codec
description: Negotiated video codec.

name: ConfigsSent
description: Decoder configurations sent.

name: DatagramsSent
description: Cumulative datagrams sent.

name: EncodedFrames
description: Cumulative frames encoded.

name: Encoder
description: Encoder element in use (native broadcaster).

name: EncoderFps
description: Frames the encoder emitted per second.

name: FramesDroppedAtSend
description: Frames dropped at the send stage.

name: KeyframeBytesSent
description: Bytes sent as keyframe streams.

name: KeyframeIntervalAvailable
description: Whether the encoder reports its keyframe interval.

name: KeyframeIntervalMs
description: Interval between keyframes.

name: KeyframeStreamsFailed
description: Keyframe streams that failed to complete.

name: KeyframeStreamsSent
description: Keyframes sent over reliable streams.

name: KeyframeStreamsSuperseded
description: Keyframe streams abandoned because a newer keyframe replaced them. Routine.

name: Keyframes
description: Cumulative keyframes produced.

name: SentFps
description: Frames put on the wire per second — the bottom of the send funnel.

name: SentFrames
description: Cumulative frames sent.

name: TimeSyncOffsetUs
description: Clock offset the time-sync exchange settled on.

name: TimeSyncRttMs
description: Round-trip of the clock-sync exchange; it bounds how much any cross-clock number can be trusted.

name: ViewerCount
description: Viewers the relay reports on this broadcast.

name: acceleration
description: Hardware-acceleration preference the encoder was configured with.

name: arrivalJitterMs
description: Spread of frame arrival intervals — the network's contribution to judder.

name: audioAnchorReanchors
description: Times the audio anchor was re-established. Each one is a discontinuity.

name: audioApp
description: Application whose audio is captured, by process binary (native broadcaster, R35).

name: audioBitrateBps
description: Audio bitrate.

name: audioBuffer
description: Audio jitter-buffer detail. Its members are flattened into facts for the rules.

name: audioBytesReceived
description: Audio bytes received.

name: audioBytesSent
description: Audio bytes sent.

name: audioChannels
description: Audio channel count.

name: audioCodec
description: Negotiated audio codec.

name: audioConfigsSent
description: Audio decoder configurations sent.

name: audioEncodeLagMs
description: How far behind real time the audio encoder is running.

name: audioEncodedPackets
description: Audio packets encoded.

name: audioEncodedPerSec
description: Audio packets encoded per second.

name: audioPacketsDecoded
description: Audio packets decoded.

name: audioPacketsDropped
description: Audio packets dropped before sending.

name: audioPacketsReceived
description: Audio packets received.

name: audioPacketsSent
description: Audio packets sent.

name: audioSampleRate
description: Audio sample rate.

name: audioSentPerSec
description: Audio packets sent per second.

name: audioSource
description: Audio source in use (native broadcaster).

name: audioState
description: State of the audio lane.

name: autoAtFloor
description: Whether the ladder has hit its floor and has nowhere left to step down.

name: autoCeiling
description: Ceiling the ladder is not allowed to exceed.

name: autoFps
description: Frame rate the auto ladder is currently asking for.

name: autoRung
description: Rung of the quality ladder currently selected.

name: autoStepDowns
description: Times the auto ladder stepped down.

name: autoStepUps
description: Times the auto ladder stepped up.

name: avMaster
description: Which clock A/V sync is slaved to.

name: avPlayheadAdvance
description: Rate the audio playhead is advancing at. A stalled playhead makes avSkewMs meaningless.

name: avSkewMs
description: Audio/video skew. Only believable while avPlayheadAdvance is near 1.

name: badDatagrams
description: Datagrams that failed to parse. Non-zero is a wire-format or corruption problem.

name: bytesSent
description: Cumulative bytes sent.

name: capToRenderMs
description: Glass-to-glass latency: capture timestamp to paint. The number this project exists to keep small.

name: captureFps
description: Frames arriving from the capture source per second.

name: captureFpsAvailable
description: Whether the capture source reports a frame rate at all.

name: capturePath
description: Capture path in use (native broadcaster).

name: captureRestarts
description: Times the native broadcaster rebuilt a capture pipeline that died mid-broadcast. Each one is a freeze the viewer saw.

name: carrierRecords
description: Records delivered over carrier streams.

name: carrierStreams
description: Carrier streams opened (resilient delivery).

name: carrierStreamsAborted
description: Carrier streams aborted.

name: codec
description: Negotiated video codec.

name: configsApplied
description: Decoder configurations applied. Each one is a decoder reset.

name: configsSent
description: Decoder configurations sent.

name: connection
description: Network Information API readings. Null in every shipping browser today (docs/13 D7).

name: datagramsReceived
description: Cumulative datagrams received.

name: datagramsSent
description: Cumulative datagrams sent.

name: decodeJitterMs
description: Spread of decode completion intervals.

name: decodedFrames
description: Cumulative frames decoded.

name: decoderFps
description: Frames the decoder emitted per second.

name: decoderQueueDepth
description: Frames waiting in the decoder. A rising depth is the decoder falling behind.

name: deliveryMode
description: How this viewer is being fed: datagrams, or a resilient carrier-stream mode.

name: documentHidden
description: Whether the tab was in the background at this sample. renderedFps means nothing without it.

name: documentHiddenMs
description: Cumulative time this tab spent in the background.

name: droppedFrames
description: Frames dropped before the encoder.

name: duplicateChunks
description: Chunks received more than once.

name: duplicateConfigs
description: Decoder configs received more than once.

name: dvrBufferMs
description: Depth of the relay-side DVR ring this viewer is reading from.

name: encodedFrames
description: Cumulative frames encoded.

name: encoder
description: Encoder element in use (native broadcaster).

name: encoderFps
description: Frames the encoder emitted per second.

name: encoderPressure
description: Whether the encoder is signalling pressure.

name: encoderQueueDepth
description: Frames waiting inside the encoder. A rising depth is the encoder losing the race.

name: featureGates
description: Which feature gates this client had on.

name: fpsGateDropped
description: Frames dropped by the frame-rate gate — intentional, not a fault.

name: frameHeight
description: Height of the frames actually arriving.

name: frameWidth
description: Width of the frames actually arriving.

name: framesAssembled
description: Cumulative frames assembled from their chunks.

name: framesCompleted
description: Cumulative frames the reassembler completed.

name: framesDiscardedAwaitingKey
description: Frames discarded while waiting for a keyframe to decode against.

name: framesDroppedAtSend
description: Frames dropped at the send stage.

name: framesDroppedIncomplete
description: Frames abandoned because chunks never arrived — the direct cost of datagram loss.

name: framesDroppedLate
description: Frames that arrived too late to be worth showing.

name: framesRecoveredByParity
description: Frames rebuilt from parity that would otherwise have been dropped.

name: framesSkippedWithinAllowance
description: Frames skipped inside the configured allowance rather than being reported as loss.

name: interpolation
description: Whether live-edge interpolation is engaged.

name: intervalMin
description: The worst reading the client saw BETWEEN two emitted samples — what makes a sub-sample dip visible at all (D16).

name: isHardwareAccelerated
description: Whether the decoder reported itself hardware-accelerated.

name: keyframeBytesSent
description: Bytes sent as keyframe streams.

name: keyframeIntervalAvailable
description: Whether the encoder reports its keyframe interval.

name: keyframeIntervalMs
description: Interval between keyframes.

name: keyframeStreamsFailed
description: Keyframe streams that failed to complete.

name: keyframeStreamsReceived
description: Keyframes delivered over reliable unidirectional streams.

name: keyframeStreamsSent
description: Keyframes sent over reliable streams.

name: keyframeStreamsSuperseded
description: Keyframe streams abandoned because a newer keyframe replaced them. Routine.

name: keyframes
description: Cumulative keyframes produced.

name: lastDecodeLatencyMs
description: Wall time the last frame spent inside the decoder.

name: lastEncodeLatencyMs
description: Wall time the last frame spent inside the encoder.

name: lastKeyframeAgeMs
description: Age of the most recent keyframe.

name: liveEdgeDriftMs
description: How far behind the live edge this viewer is running.

name: memAvailable
description: Whether the OS reported the process's memory (R76).

name: memCaptureBytes
description: Captured frames held between capture and the encoder (frame pool, conversion targets) at pixel size. Mostly GPU memory, so it explains memGpuBytes more than the footprint.

name: memCommitBytes
description: Windows only: committed private memory, resident or paged out (Task Manager's Commit size). A leak that pages out leaves the footprint and stays here.

name: memEncodeBytes
description: Encoded frames waiting between the encoder and the sender.

name: memFootprintBytes
description: Memory the native broadcaster's process holds, in the figure the OS's own task manager shows: Windows' private working set, Apple's phys_footprint, Linux's anonymous + shared resident pages. The budget is 100 MiB while live.

name: memFootprintPeakBytes
description: Highest footprint of the process: the kernel's own peak on Apple, the highest sampled elsewhere.

name: memGpuAvailable
description: Whether the process's video memory is measured: Windows and Apple, not Linux (R76).

name: memGpuBytes
description: Video memory charged to the process: DXGI's per-process usage over every adapter on Windows (dedicated and shared), the kernel's graphics ledger on Apple.

name: memHeapAvailable
description: Whether the Rust heap is counted: the shell runs the counting allocator (R76).

name: memHeapBytes
description: The broadcaster's own Rust heap. Footprint minus this is memory held through libraries: the GPU driver, the media frameworks, the UI renderer.

name: memHeapPeakBytes
description: Highest Rust heap of the process.

name: memLimitRemainingBytes
description: iOS only: memory left before the system ends the app for using too much.

name: memPreviewBytes
description: The live thumbnail and the Ready page's source preview, as pixels.

name: memResidentBytes
description: Every resident page of the process, shared libraries and file-backed pages included (working set / RSS).

name: memSendBytes
description: Encoded video the sender holds: carrier records queued for the uplink and the keyframe waiting for its stream. QUIC's own buffers are not in it.

name: memTelemetryBytes
description: Telemetry batches waiting to be posted.

name: parityBytesSent
description: Bytes spent on parity.

name: parityChunksReceived
description: Forward-parity chunks received (R29).

name: parityChunksSent
description: Parity chunks sent.

name: parityLevel
description: Parity chunks generated per frame.

name: parityRecoveryFailures
description: Frames where parity was attempted and still failed.

name: pipelineContext
description: Which context the pipeline is running in (main thread or worker).

name: playoutMode
description: Adaptive or fixed playout scheduling.

name: playoutOffsetMs
description: The adaptive playout buffer's current depth. Pinned at its clamp means the controller ran out of room.

name: presentation
description: The presentation path in use.

name: presentationMux
description: iOS fMP4 muxer state.

name: presentationSurface
description: Presentation surface state.

name: receivedFps
description: Frames fully reassembled from datagrams per second — the top of the viewer funnel.

name: renderCadenceP95Ms
description: 95th-percentile paint interval. Invalid while the tab is hidden.

name: renderCadenceStdDevMs
description: Spread of the interval between paints. Judder, measured.

name: renderedFps
description: Frames actually painted per second. Collapses to 0 in a hidden tab; read it beside documentHidden.

name: renderer
description: The render path that actually engaged — the answer to 'did the fast path take?'

name: reorderBuffered
description: Frames currently held in the reorder buffer.

name: reorderGapResyncs
description: Times the reorder buffer gave up on a gap and resynchronised.

name: reorderKeyframeWaitDrops
description: Frames dropped while the reorder buffer waited for a keyframe.

name: resumes
description: Times the native broadcaster resumed a broadcast.

name: resuming
description: Whether the native broadcaster is mid-resume.

name: sentFps
description: Frames put on the wire per second — the bottom of the send funnel.

name: sentFrames
description: Cumulative frames sent.

name: shareMode
description: What the desktop's picker returned: screen or window (native broadcaster, R35).

name: staleAudioDropped
description: Audio packets the browser's send queue dropped as more than a GOP old when their turn came.

name: staleChunks
description: Chunks rejected behind the emit watermark. Routine leg-skew stragglers while striped; phantom-frame evidence anywhere else.

name: staleFramesDropped
description: Frames the browser's send queue dropped as stale: more than a GOP old when their turn came, or of a GOP whose keyframe waited behind a late one. An upload that cannot keep up, not a fault.

name: stripeActive
description: Connections currently carrying this viewer's datagrams (R30).

name: stripeCapable
description: Whether this client can stripe at all.

name: stripeLargeChunks
description: Chunks in the largest recent frame.

name: stripeLargeLossPct
description: Chunk loss on large frames — the burst-threshold signature.

name: stripeLegDeaths
description: Striped connections that died.

name: stripeLegDials
description: Additional connections dialled.

name: stripeMode
description: Requested striping mode (R30): off, auto, or a fixed leg count.

name: stripeNeeded
description: Connections the detector believes are needed. Diverging from stripeActive is caps pressure.

name: stripeSmallLossPct
description: Chunk loss on small frames. Clean here while large is lossy is the shape striping exists for.

name: targetBitrateBps
description: Bitrate the broadcast was asked to produce.

name: targetFps
description: Frame rate the broadcast was asked to produce. Without it a shortfall is not computable.

name: targetHeight
description: Height the broadcast was asked to produce.

name: targetWidth
description: Width the broadcast was asked to produce.

name: timeSinceLastFrameMs
description: How long since the last frame. Past 1000 ms this is a stall a viewer notices.

name: timeSinceLastInboundMs
description: How long since anything at all arrived on the transport.

name: timeSyncAvailable
description: Whether clock sync is available on this path.

name: timeSyncOffsetUs
description: Clock offset the time-sync exchange settled on.

name: timeSyncRttMs
description: Round-trip of the clock-sync exchange; it bounds how much any cross-clock number can be trusted.

name: transport
description: The transport in use.

name: uplinkCarriersExpired
description: Uplink carriers reset before the relay acknowledged all of them: past the 150 ms retire deadline, or abandoned when a newer keyframe superseded a blocked write (R73). Video viewers lost.

name: uplinkCarriersOpened
description: Uplink carriers the native broadcaster opened, one per GOP in Reliable delivery (R73).

name: uplinkCongestion
description: The QUIC congestion controller of the publish connection: cubic or bbr (R73).

name: uplinkDatagramsDropped
description: Datagrams the native broadcaster handed to QUIC that never left in a packet: dropped from quinn's own send buffer when it was full. Includes, for a moment, datagrams still queued at the instant of the sample.

name: uplinkMode
description: How the native broadcaster's deltas leave: datagram or carrier (R73).

name: uplinkModeRequested
description: The Delivery setting asked for: reliable or lowest-latency (R73). Differs from uplinkMode on a relay without carriers.

name: uplinkPacketsAvailable
description: Whether the native broadcaster's transport reports QUIC packet counters.

name: uplinkPacketsLost
description: QUIC packets the native broadcaster's stack declared lost on the way to the relay. The only local view of leg-A loss: Wi-Fi drops (AWDL on a Mac) move no other counter.

name: uplinkPacketsSent
description: QUIC packets the native broadcaster sent to the relay, summed across resumes.

name: uplinkRecordsShed
description: Delta records that never reached a carrier: shed with a superseded GOP or abandoned mid-write (R73). In Reliable delivery this, not lost packets, is what leg A cost viewers.

name: uplinkWarning
description: Whether the browser broadcaster was being told its upload can't keep up (five bad seconds raise it, fifteen good ones clear it).

name: videoBytesReceived
description: Cumulative video bytes received.

name: videoScheduleBaseEpochMs
description: Epoch the video schedule is anchored to.

name: viewerCount
description: Viewers the relay reports on this broadcast.

name: viewerCountAvailable
description: Whether a viewer count is available on this path.
